hypotheses.N1_tangent_basis_has_specific_local_adva: The discovery tangent rank-64 basis retains at least 0.10 more held-out tangent energy than the matched native-state rank-64 basis for every target and boundary.
hypotheses.N2_tangent_basis_has_specific_causal_adv: The tangent basis preserves at least 0.10 more final Fisher-response fidelity than the native-state basis for every target and boundary.
hypotheses.N3_tangent_and_native_subspaces_are_dist: Their leading-64 mean squared canonical cosine is at most 0.50 at every boundary.
hypotheses.N4_native_state_basis_is_more_split_stab: Native-state split stability exceeds tangent-basis split stability by at least 0.20 at every boundary.
hypotheses.N5_static_vocabulary_failure_is_not_just: N1 and N2 both hold, establishing that the weak rank-64 tangent result is not explained by using an ordinary native activation basis.
